programs.name: zero_gated_phase_shrinkage
programs.description: Use when hourly activity occupies stable daily phases but amplitudes vary sharply; it addresses the 73.86-point fold-score range by shrinking the latest day toward recent phase medians while preserving consensus zeros.
programs.assumption: In the next 24 points, at least 10 of the 13 phases that were zero in both observed daily cycles remain zero, and the phase-shrunk forecast has lower SMAPE than copying the latest cycle.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when the activity window shifts to previously zero phases or the newest cycle is a reliable level regime that should not be shrunk.

programs.name: recurring_event_block
programs.description: Use when each day contains one contiguous burst surrounded by structural zeros; it models the two observed 11-point blocks directly instead of allowing unstable cycle-level drift.
programs.assumption: The next activity block begins within 1 hourly phase of phase 7, lasts between 9 and 13 hours, and its total magnitude lies between 70% and 130% of the median total of the two historical blocks.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when the next day has multiple separated events, no event, or an onset shift larger than one hour.

programs.name: consensus_geometric_analog
programs.description: Use when daily phase support is more stable than magnitude and spike sizes behave multiplicatively; consensus activation limits false positives while geometric averaging dampens the amplitude instability reflected in the 76.38 SMAPE fold.
programs.assumption: At least 9 of the 11 phases active in both observed cycles remain active next cycle, and their log1p magnitudes are closer to the cross-cycle geometric means than to the latest-cycle values.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when active phases move, when only one historical cycle contains the emerging event, or when magnitudes follow additive rather than multiplicative changes.
